question: What is the value of (25 times 25-12 times 12+13 times 13)/(12 times 5+10 div 2)?
solution:
**Calculation:**

(25 times 25-12 times 12+13 times 13)/(12 times 5+10 div 2)

⇒ (625-144+169)/(60+5)

⇒(650)/(65) 

= 10

**∴ The correct option is 1**
